entry.summaryHtml: Earth, white pepper, cedar, molasses and roasted espresso give the Sun Grown Juniors a dry, spicy-sweet profile with more edge than creaminess. The 4″ × 38 format should keep the Sumatra wrapper prominent, with pepper and wood up front, darker coffee through the middle and a slightly sticky molasses note on the finish.

note: Replace discussion of other Rocky Patel cigars with a direct description of the Sun Grown Juniors.
